folio_note: Texto en clave, adjunta copia | 2 p.; the attached 'copia' may be a clear copy (then read at the time) or a second cipher copy
status: Archivo Nacional de Chile catalogue (Aleph ARNES) note: 'Texto en clave, adjunta copia', no transcription noted (the catalogue does note one on most sibling telegrams). Not digitised online (no 856 link in the MARC record). The same fonds holds 142 cipher telegrams of 1879-1886 with transcriptions attached and two key sheets: A3039 "Código para escribir en clave" (ca. 1880) and B4931 "Claves telegráficas a utilizar con Lynch, Altamirano, Novoa y todas las legaciones chilenas en el extranjero" (ca. 1883, 10 p.). Not on DECODE, not in the repo (checked 28 Oct 2026).
why: Occupation-era reporting from Lima, during the Sierra campaign.
